## Summary

Discovered as a part of: https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/105238

When reading fields from source, we're not showing multifields, although we should. This PR fixes that.

issue.title: Fix failure on attempt to overwrite multi fields

labels.name: :Search Foundations/Mapping
labels.description: Index mappings, including merging and defining field types

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
We used to throw a parsing exception when trying to overwrite a multi field on
indexing a document. These errors got lost on some recent changes in
DocumentParser around runtime fields and not detected in tests. This PR adds a
test for this case and restores parts of the logic in
DocumentParser#getLeafMapper to prevent this kind of overwrite from happening.

Fixes #75343
